components.name: Bar
components.description: One row with slots: leading icon, label, trailing hint. Like a Card cut to a single line. Every slot is optional. Renders a button by default; pass `asChild` to render a link or a static row. To open a menu, pass the bar as a menu's `trigger`.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading slot: an icon, avatar, status dot.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Keyboard hint shown at the end, e.g. "Ctrl+N". Display only.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Replaces the shortcut slot with anything, such as a badge or chevron.

props.name: active
props.description: Marks the bar as the current one, e.g. the selected nav row.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Renders the single child element as the bar, such as an `<a>`, a `<Link>` or a static `<div>`. The child's own children fill the label slot when `label` is not set.
